queries.QualityKpi: SELECT * FROM ads.cd_quality_kpi WHERE build_id IN (11,10)
queries.SnapshotSources: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM ads.release_job_detail WHERE release_id=8
queries.SnapshotJobs: SELECT CONCAT(release_id,'|',date_key,'|',job_key) AS snapshot_key,* FROM ads.release_job_detail WHERE release_id=8
queries.SnapshotCityJobs: SELECT snapshot_key,city_name,province_name FROM ads.release_city_detail WHERE release_id=8
queries.SnapshotSkillJobs: SELECT snapshot_key,job_key,skill_name FROM ads.release_skill_detail WHERE release_id=8
queries.SnapshotSkills: SELECT DISTINCT skill_name FROM ads.release_skill_detail WHERE release_id=8

cd_scope: latest selected input per source; historical pilot projection
note: All queries pinned before refresh; no fact-to-fact/content relationship.
